item.text: The first CLI handoff did not switch the visible content, so I’m going to drive the existing Thunderbird window with keyboard input and open `about:profiles` inside it.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "DISPLAY=:0 python3 - <<'PY'
import pyautogui, time
pyautogui.click(1120,145)  # dismiss low disk notification with Ignore
# Focus Thunderbird and try internal location opening
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl','l')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.write('about:profiles', interval=0.01)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(1)
pyautogui.screenshot('/tmp/thunderbird-after-ctrl-l.png')
PY"
